\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{সন্তান} (sôntān)}{সন্তান (sôntān)}]{\bn{সন্তান} (sôntān) — a child (as offspring); offspring}

\label{lesson:BN-C484-sontan}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a husband's younger brother, then the Bengali for a husband's elder brother.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{সন্তান}}
\textbf{\bn{সন্তান}} — \emph{sôntān} — \textquotedblleft{}a child (as offspring); offspring\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমার} \bn{কাকার} \bn{দুই} \bn{সন্তান।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{āmār kākār dui sôntān.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
My uncle has two children.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{সন্তান}} (\emph{sôntān}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{saṃtāna}, \textquotedblleft{}continued succession\textquotedblright{}, and so \textquotedblleft{}offspring\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams): what carries the family on.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sôntān}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{sôntān}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{āmār kākār dui sôntān.} — My uncle has two children.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a husband's younger brother, then the Bengali for a husband's elder brother, then say \emph{sôntān} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{সন্তান} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A child (as offspring); offspring\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{যমজ} (jômôj)}{যমজ (jômôj)}]{\bn{যমজ} (jômôj) — twins; a twin}

\label{lesson:BN-C484-jomoj}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for a husband's elder brother, then the Bengali for offspring.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{যমজ}}
\textbf{\bn{যমজ}} — \emph{jômôj} — \textquotedblleft{}twins; a twin\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমার} \bn{কাকিমার} \bn{যমজ} \bn{ছেলে} \bn{হল।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{āmār kākimār jômôj chhele hôlô.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
My aunt had twin boys.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{যমজ}} (\emph{jômôj}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{yamaja}, \textquotedblleft{}twin-born\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams), from \emph{yama}, a twin, and \emph{ja}, born.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{jômôj}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{jômôj}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{āmār kākimār jômôj chhele hôlô.} — My aunt had twin boys.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for a husband's elder brother, then the Bengali for offspring, then say \emph{jômôj} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{যমজ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}Twins; a twin\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{বংশ} (bôngshô)}{বংশ (bôngshô)}]{\bn{বংশ} (bôngshô) — a family line; lineage}

\label{lesson:BN-C484-bongsho}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for offspring, then the Bengali for twins.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{বংশ}}
\textbf{\bn{বংশ}} — \emph{bôngshô} — \textquotedblleft{}a family line; lineage\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমাদের} \bn{বংশ} \bn{এই} \bn{গ্রামে} \bn{একশো} \bn{বছর} \bn{ধরে} \bn{আছে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{āmāder bôngshô ei grāme eksho bôchhôr dhôre āchhe.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Our family line has been in this village for a hundred years.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{বংশ}} (\emph{bôngshô}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{vaṃśa}, both \textquotedblleft{}a bamboo cane\textquotedblright{} and \textquotedblleft{}a lineage\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams); \bn{বাঁশ} (taught), bamboo, is the same word worn down.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bôngshô}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{bôngshô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{āmāder bôngshô ei grāme eksho bôchhôr dhôre āchhe.} — Our family line has been in this village for a hundred years.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for offspring, then the Bengali for twins, then say \emph{bôngshô} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{বংশ} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A family line; lineage\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{প্রজন্ম} (prôjônmô)}{প্রজন্ম (prôjônmô)}]{\bn{প্রজন্ম} (prôjônmô) — a generation}

\label{lesson:BN-C484-projonmo}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for twins, then the Bengali for lineage.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{প্রজন্ম}}
\textbf{\bn{প্রজন্ম}} — \emph{prôjônmô} — \textquotedblleft{}a generation\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{নতুন} \bn{প্রজন্ম} \bn{ফোনে} \bn{গান} \bn{শোনে।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{nôtun prôjônmô phone gān shone.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
The new generation listens to music on their phones.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{প্রজন্ম}} (\emph{prôjônmô}) is a modern formation from Sanskrit \emph{pra-}, \textquotedblleft{}forth\textquotedblright{}, and \emph{janman}, \textquotedblleft{}birth\textquotedblright{} (CDIAL 5113), the \bn{জন্ম} of \bn{জন্মদিন} (taught), a birthday.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

\subsection*{Your turn}
\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{prôjônmô}
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{prôjônmô}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{nôtun prôjônmô phone gān shone.} — The new generation listens to music on their phones.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for twins, then the Bengali for lineage, then say \emph{prôjônmô} again
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
What does \bn{প্রজন্ম} mean? (\textquotedblleft{}A generation\textquotedblright{}.) Say it once more.
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[\texorpdfstring{\bn{পূর্বপুরুষ} (pūrbôpurush)}{পূর্বপুরুষ (pūrbôpurush)}]{\bn{পূর্বপুরুষ} (pūrbôpurush) — an ancestor; the forefathers}

\label{lesson:BN-C484-purbopurush}



\begin{quote}
Before the new one: say the Bengali for lineage, then the Bengali for a generation.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{You'll want to know: \bn{পূর্বপুরুষ}}
\textbf{\bn{পূর্বপুরুষ}} — \emph{pūrbôpurush} — \textquotedblleft{}an ancestor; the forefathers\textquotedblright{}.

\begin{quote}
\bn{আমাদের} \bn{পূর্বপুরুষরা} \bn{নদীর} \bn{ধারে} \bn{থাকতেন।}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
\emph{āmāder pūrbôpurushrā nôdīr dhāre thākten.}
\end{quote}

\begin{quote}
Our ancestors lived on the riverbank.
\end{quote}

\begin{cousinweb}
\textbf{\bn{পূর্বপুরুষ}} (\emph{pūrbôpurush}) is a tatsama, Sanskrit \emph{pūrvapuruṣa}, \textquotedblleft{}a forefather\textquotedblright{} (Monier-Williams): \emph{pūrva} \textquotedblleft{}earlier\textquotedblright{} with \emph{puruṣa} \textquotedblleft{}man\textquotedblright{}.
\end{cousinweb}

\begin{grammarlens}[title={What you've built}]
One more word for describing what you lived and felt.
\end{grammarlens}

  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{pūrbôpurush}, once more
  \item \emph{Say it:} \emph{āmāder pūrbôpurushrā nôdīr dhāre thākten.} — Our ancestors lived on the riverbank.
  \item \emph{Recall:} say the Bengali for lineage, then the Bengali for a generation, then say \emph{pūrbôpurush} again
\end{itemize}

\section[(dialogue)]{Looking back: from At the Sickbed to Children and Lineage}

\label{lesson:BN-R484-review-478-484}



\begin{quote}
Say the Bengali for care and nursing.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item care, nursing, a thermometer, a cold compress, to nurse
  \item sleep, insomnia, drowsiness, to nod off, to stretch on waking
  \item nutrition, meditation, an addiction, smoking, to shed
  \item a mother, an elder brother, an elder sister, an elder brother's wife, a paternal grandmother
  \item a father's elder brother, a maternal aunt's husband, a sister's son, a brother's daughter, a child's father-in-law
  \item a son-in-law, a daughter-in-law, a husband's sister, a husband's younger brother, a husband's elder brother
  \item offspring, twins, lineage, a generation, an ancestor
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Care? (\textbf{\bn{যত্ন}}, \emph{jôtnô}.) Nursing? (\textbf{\bn{সেবা}}, \emph{sebā}.) A thermometer? (\textbf{\bn{থার্মোমিটার}}, \emph{thārmomiṭār}.) A cold compress? (\textbf{\bn{জলপট্টি}}, \emph{jôlpôṭṭi}.) To nurse? (\textbf{\bn{শুশ্রূষা} \bn{করা}}, \emph{shushrūshā kôrā}.) Sleep? (\textbf{\bn{ঘুম}}, \emph{ghum}.) Insomnia? (\textbf{\bn{অনিদ্রা}}, \emph{ônidrā}.) Drowsiness? (\textbf{\bn{তন্দ্রা}}, \emph{tôndrā}.) To nod off? (\textbf{\bn{ঝিমানো}}, \emph{jhimāno}.) To stretch on waking? (\textbf{\bn{আড়মোড়া} \bn{ভাঙা}}, \emph{āṛmoṛā bhāngā}.) Nutrition? (\textbf{\bn{পুষ্টি}}, \emph{pushṭi}.) Meditation? (\textbf{\bn{ধ্যান}}, \emph{dhæn}.) An addiction? (\textbf{\bn{নেশা}}, \emph{neshā}.) Smoking? (\textbf{\bn{ধূমপান}}, \emph{dhūmpān}.) To shed? (\textbf{\bn{ঝরানো}}, \emph{jhôrāno}.) A mother? (\textbf{\bn{মা}}, \emph{mā}.) An elder brother? (\textbf{\bn{দাদা}}, \emph{dādā}.) An elder sister? (\textbf{\bn{দিদি}}, \emph{didi}.) An elder brother's wife? (\textbf{\bn{বউদি}}, \emph{boudi}.) A paternal grandmother? (\textbf{\bn{ঠাকুমা}}, \emph{ṭhākumā}.) A father's elder brother? (\textbf{\bn{জেঠা}}, \emph{jeṭhā}.) A maternal aunt's husband? (\textbf{\bn{মেসো}}, \emph{meso}.) A sister's son? (\textbf{\bn{ভাগ্নে}}, \emph{bhāgne}.) A brother's daughter? (\textbf{\bn{ভাইঝি}}, \emph{bhāijhi}.) A child's father-in-law? (\textbf{\bn{বেয়াই}}, \emph{beyāi}.) A son-in-law? (\textbf{\bn{জামাই}}, \emph{jāmāi}.) A daughter-in-law? (\textbf{\bn{বউমা}}, \emph{boumā}.) A husband's sister? (\textbf{\bn{ননদ}}, \emph{nônôd}.) A husband's younger brother? (\textbf{\bn{দেওর}}, \emph{deor}.) A husband's elder brother? (\textbf{\bn{ভাশুর}}, \emph{bhāshur}.) Offspring? (\textbf{\bn{সন্তান}}, \emph{sôntān}.) Twins? (\textbf{\bn{যমজ}}, \emph{jômôj}.) Lineage? (\textbf{\bn{বংশ}}, \emph{bôngshô}.) A generation? (\textbf{\bn{প্রজন্ম}}, \emph{prôjônmô}.) An ancestor? (\textbf{\bn{পূর্বপুরুষ}}, \emph{pūrbôpurush}.)
